settlements.title: Breckenridge Duloxetine Future Refund Program
settlements.description: An ongoing refund program (not a fixed one-time settlement) for consumers who purchased Breckenridge duloxetine (generic Cymbalta) later subject to a product recall occurring after May 22, 2025. Unlike a typical proof-of-purchase claim, this program requires physically returning the unused, recalled medication in addition to filing a claim form — you'll receive a Return Authorization and prepaid shipping label by email after submitting your claim. Check the official site's recalled-lot list (Exhibit 1) to confirm your specific product is covered before filing.
settlements.eligibilityCriteria: You purchased Breckenridge duloxetine that was recalled after May 22, 2025, and still have unused product to return. See the official recalled-lots list (Exhibit 1) on the settlement website to confirm your lot is covered.
settlements.payoutText: Refund of your actual out-of-pocket cost for the returned recalled product — no fixed amount, no cap stated on the official site.
settlements.sourceName: Official settlement website, verified directly (not via aggregator)

settlements.title: Comcast (Xfinity) 2023 Data Breach Settlement
settlements.description: Settlement resolving a class action over an October 2023 cybersecurity incident in which a third party gained unauthorized access to Comcast/Xfinity customers' personal information. Comcast denies any wrongdoing. Settlement Class Members can either request a no-documentation Alternative Cash Payment (estimated $50, subject to pro rata adjustment) or submit documentation for Out-of-Pocket Losses and Lost Time reimbursement instead. All Class Members also get free Identity Defense and Restoration Services once the settlement is final. A Final Approval Hearing was held August 5, 2026; the Court had not yet ruled on final approval as of this record's verification date, but claims are being accepted regardless through the deadline below.
settlements.eligibilityCriteria: You are a Settlement Class Member if you were sent notice around December 18, 2023 that your personal information may have been compromised in the October 2023 Comcast/Xfinity data breach. Case: Hasson v. Comcast Cable Communications, LLC, No. 2:23-cv-05039-JMY (E.D. Pa.).
settlements.payoutText: $50 with no proof needed, or documented losses plus up to $150 for lost time ($30/hr, up to 5 hrs) — both figures confirmed directly on the official FAQ, no cap stated beyond that.
settlements.sourceName: Official court-authorized settlement website, verified directly (not via aggregator)
